ranks: Marvel Super Heroes Commander (MSC, 2026-06-26): top 50% by EDHREC rank, its next 60 (Council of Reeds is a token, authored as one)

blocked.name: She-Hulk, Wallbreaker
blocked.why: "put a +1/+1 counter on that Hero for each creature blocking it": no amount counts the creatures blocking the trigger object (one blocked-by trigger per blocker would be N counter events, not one)

blocked.name: Living Laser
blocked.why: "for each card you've discarded this turn": no discard tally, and create-token-copy's count is a fixed number

blocked.name: Typhoid Mary, Fractured
blocked.why: "if you discarded a card this turn, you choose one instead" needs a discard tally, and a triggered ability's random mode is picked as it goes on the stack (modal random is resolution-time only)

blocked.name: Captain Marvel, Apex Avenger
blocked.why: "put the same number and kind of counters on Captain Marvel": add-counter takes a fixed counter kind; nothing reads the kind the counters-put trigger saw

blocked.name: Doctor Strange, Surgeon
blocked.why: "if you have at least 10 life more than your starting life total": life-total's atLeast is a fixed number

blocked.name: Kang Dynasty
blocked.why: "Until your next turn, whenever any of those creatures deals combat damage to a player, draw a card": the dealsCombatDamage delayed trigger lapses at end of turn

blocked.name: The Thanos-Copter
blocked.why: "Vehicles you control become artifact creatures until end of turn": add-types is single-target and animate-all sets base P/T

blocked.name: Loki, Lord of Misrule
blocked.why: 'Each creature you control other than the chosen creature becomes a copy of it until end of turn, except it isn't legendary': become-copy takes one target, no filter/each form.

blocked.name: The Squadron Sinister
blocked.why: Mayhem {3}{U}{R} (cast from graveyard if discarded this turn) isn't built.

blocked.name: Abomination, World Ravager
blocked.why: Mayhem {4}{R} isn't built; the rest is keywords.

blocked.name: Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings
blocked.why: 'When the tenth +1/+1 counter is put on Shang-Chi' needs a trigger on crossing a counter count; counters-put can't see the count before.

blocked.name: Willie Lumpkin, Postman
blocked.why: The each-player-may draw is expressible, but 'that player can't attack you or permanents you control during their next turn' has no player-level attack prohibition with that duration.

blocked.name: Thor, Asgard's Avenger
blocked.why: would-deal-damage has fromSelf but no 'another source you control' (excluding this object); a notName filter would wrongly exclude copies.

blocked.name: Everett K. Ross, Hapless Attaché
blocked.why: attack-with's attackingYou also counts attackers on your planeswalkers; 'attacks you with two or more creatures' counts only those attacking you (rule 508.3e).

blocked.name: Panther Habit
blocked.why: would-deal-damage's `to` has no 'attached' recipient, and its `then` acts from the Equipment, so counters can't go on the equipped creature

blocked.name: Archnemesis
blocked.why: 'you may attach this Aura to that player' moves an Aura onto the attacking player (not the trigger-player); no effect attaches an Aura to a player

blocked.name: Reed Richards, Smartest Man
blocked.why: would-draw `draws: N` ignores exceptFirstInDrawStep and has no 'first time each turn' limit

blocked.name: Heroic Sacrifice
blocked.why: redirecting all damage to you and your creatures onto a chosen creature until end of turn isn't expressible

blocked.name: Jocasta, Automaton Avenger
blocked.why: put-onto-battlefield has no `attacking`, so 'return it to the battlefield tapped and attacking' from the graveyard can't be said

blocked.name: Fight for the Throne
blocked.why: the delayed 'when that creature dies this turn, if you control your commander' needs an intervening-if on a delayed trigger; a resolution-only conditional would be wrong

blocked.name: Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper
blocked.why: '+1/+0 for each artifact defending player controls' — countOf reads only from the controller's or a target player's side, not the trigger-player's

blocked.name: Invisible Force Field
blocked.why: rebound isn't modeled
